About the business area, Group Compliance & Governance

Compliance is an independent function at ADCB which takes an active approach to risk management and monitoring, ensuring the Bank complies with applicable laws, regulations, rules and market standards. The Group creates, implements and monitors policies and procedures designed to prevent or detect financial crime and any compliance breaches of the Bank, its employees and clients. It also monitors and measures the impact of conduct risk and compliance on the Bank’s risk appetite and profile.
q: At least 4 years of experience in Banking in Compliance, Branch or Operations
Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce or Business Administration
Understanding of account opening and customer documentation
Knowledge of customer transactions and behaviours
Understanding of local/International and Central Bank rules and regulatory requirements

r: Ensure account opening/Know Your Customer (KYC) documentation is correct and up-to-date, conduct quality client due diligence factoring Anti Money Laundering/Combatting the Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) and sanctions risks, liaise with business units and vigilance and control team to ensure quality of KYC forms and documents.

Review system generated alerts against customer data, investigate for potential money laundering/terrorist financing/sanctions risks, collect documentary proof, build/maintain case files for transactions and customers deemed suspicious, update relevant Management Information System (MIS) to ensure accurate tracking and record keeping, update internal watch-lists, identify tainted/blacklisted names and carry out required actions in order to fulfil regulatory requirements and avoid penalties

Support projects arising out of changes in regulations in order to ensure remedial actions are completed and fulfil regulatory requirements

d: We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Operations Manager to lead, optimize, and oversee end-to-end express delivery and hub operations. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring seamless first-mile, sorting, transportation, and last-mile operations while driving service efficiency, maintaining safety compliance, and meeting operational KPIs.
q: Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience: 3–5+ years of experience in express delivery, last-mile logistics, e-commerce operations, or supply chain management.
Leadership: Proven track record in managing large operational teams and multi-site hub operations.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in logistics management systems (WMS/TMS), MS Excel, and operational data analytics.
Key Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, high stress tolerance in a fast-paced environment, and clear stakeholder communication.
Language Requirements: Fluency in English (Hindi/Urdu or Arabic fluency is often preferred depending on the regional market).
r: Manage end-to-end logistics operations, including pickup, sorting, transportation, and last-mile parcel delivery.
Monitor daily branch/hub activities to ensure operational targets and service level agreements (SLAs) are met consistently.
Plan and optimize delivery routes and driver dispatch schedules to reduce transit times and operational costs.
Track and report on key operational metrics, such as On-Time Delivery (OTD), delivery success rate, and cost-per-parcel.
Drive process improvement initiatives to reduce parcel damage, missing rates, and customer complaints.
Conduct regular reviews of operational efficiency and present reports to senior management.
Lead, mentor, and manage supervisors, sorting staff, couriers, and fleet personnel.
Oversee manpower planning, shift schedules, peak-season resource allocation, and recruitment needs.
Foster a safe, high-performance, and accountable work environment.
Ensure full compliance with company SOPs, safety policies, and local labor/transportation regulations.
Enforce strict protocols around proof of delivery (POD), parcel handling, and inventory control.
